mods.description: A lightweight Fabric client-side mod that adds a GUI to log in using Minecraft session IDs. Includes a status display (Valid/Invalid) and integrates cleanly into the multiplayer menu without affecting gameplay or server-side behavior.

releases.notes:
## 🎉 Session ID Login Mod – Release v1.1.0

This release adds critical compatibility for servers that enforce chat signature verification during login.

### ✨ New Features

* 🔐 **Chat Signature Support**  
  Servers requiring valid chat signatures for authentication are now fully supported. Session logins will properly include the cryptographic keys needed for signed chat, allowing you to connect to servers with `enforce-secure-profile=true`.

### 🧠 Improvements

* Improved session validation to handle signature-based authentication flows.

### 📦 Requirements

* Minecraft `1.21.11`
* Fabric Loader
* Fabric API
* Java 21

Place the JAR in your `.minecraft/mods` folder and launch with a Fabric-enabled profile.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/AdditionalLibraries-Dev/Fabric-Session-Login/commits/1.1.0
